name: Reactive VCR

params.help: Track that drives the effect; empty = the source video's audio
params.label: Audio

params.help: How far the low end bends and widens the tracking band.
params.label: Bass → tracking wobble

params.help: How far each beat or transient tears the bottom of the picture sideways.
params.label: Hits → head-switch tear

params.help: How much snow the overall level adds.
params.label: Loudness → snow

params.help: How much the high end speckles the colour.
params.label: Highs → colour noise

params.help: How long each artifact takes to fade after the sound that caused it.
params.label: Settle time

params.help: How readily a transient counts as a hit.
params.label: Hit sensitivity

params.help: A reactive-vcr mapping (TOML) to use instead of the sliders, e.g. presets/reactive-vcr.toml
params.label: Map

simple.blurb: Tape damage that moves with the sound: bass bends the picture, hits tear it.
simple.name: Sound Reactive

steps.name: render
steps.script:
audio=${GB_P_AUDIO:-$GB_SOURCE_AUDIO}
if [ -z "$audio" ]; then
  echo "reactive-vcr: the source has no audio track; choose an Audio file" >&2
  exit 1
fi
map=$GB_P_MAP
if [ -z "$map" ]; then
  # No Map file: build the mapping from the sliders. ReactiveVCRStep.mapping (iOS) writes the same text.
  map=$GB_WORK/map.toml
  jq -r '
def f3: (. * 1000 | round) as $n | "\($n / 1000 | floor).\("000\($n % 1000)"[-3:])";
def ms($base): ($base * ([0.2, 2 * .response] | max)) | round | tostring;
def block($target; $source; $lines): "\n[[modulate]]\ntarget = \"\($target)\"\nsource = \"\($source)\"\n" + ($lines | map(. + "\n") | add);
"# Built by Glitchbox from the Reactive VCR sliders.\n\n[audio]\nbands.bass = [20, 200]\nbands.high = [3000, 12000]\nnormalize = \"percentile:98\"\nonset_sensitivity = \(.sensitivity | f3)\n"
+ (if .bass > 0 then
    block("tracking_noise"; "rms"; ["threshold = 0.0"])
    + block("tracking_noise_wave_intensity"; "band:bass"; ["range = [\(4 * .bass | f3), \(50 * .bass | f3)]", "curve = \"pow:2\"", "attack_ms = 10", "release_ms = \(ms(300))"])
    + block("tracking_noise_height"; "band:bass"; ["range = [\(12 * .bass | round), \(120 * .bass | round)]", "release_ms = \(ms(200))"])
  else "" end)
+ (if .hits > 0 then
    block("head_switching"; "onset"; ["threshold = 0.5", "release_ms = \(ms(120))"])
    + block("head_switching_horizontal_shift"; "onset"; ["range = [0.000, \(80 * .hits | f3)]", "release_ms = \(ms(120))"])
  else "" end)
+ (if .level > 0 then block("snow_intensity"; "rms"; ["range = [0.000, \(4 * .level | f3)]", "curve = \"exp\"", "release_ms = \(ms(400))"]) else "" end)
+ (if .highs > 0 then block("chroma_noise_intensity"; "band:high"; ["range = [0.000, \(0.8 * .highs | f3)]", "release_ms = \(ms(150))"]) else "" end)
  ' "$GB_PARAMS" > "$map"
fi
# The pipeline, not the same-named binary that precedes it on PATH.
"$GB_ROOT/pipelines/reactive-vcr" --audio "$audio" --map "$map" --audio-mode none -o "$GB_OUT" "$GB_IN"

summary: Audio-reactive VCR artifacts (pipelines/reactive-vcr): bass bends the tracking, hits tear the picture, loudness adds snow, and highs add colour noise. Driven by the source video's own audio unless an audio file is chosen. A Map file replaces the sliders.
